correctness.rationale: In H_n (n>=2) defined by a_i~b_j iff i<=j, no induced 2K2 occurs. Any induced path with at least five vertices contains two disjoint first/last edges inducing 2K2, so all induced paths have at most four vertices; an independent set meets each such path at most twice. Conversely, if S of size>=3 contains edge a_i b_j (i<=j), every third a_k or b_l supplies an induced 3- or 4-vertex path containing the triple using the index comparisons k<=j or k>j, l>=i or l<i; hence S fails. Thus S is monophonic position iff |S|<=2 or independent. Every independent k>=3 set is represented uniquely by k distinct increasing indices, split at B-prefix/A-suffix r=0..k, giving (k+1)C(n,k) and the complete enumerator; maximum n with n+1 canonical cuts when n>=3, while n=2 six two-sets. Fresh independent induced-path enumeration and exhaustive subsets n=2..6 (16+64+256+1024+4096 =5456 masks; generated paths 3,13,35,75,140) confirmed the exact test/polynomial. The bound for all n is structural, not based on the finite experiment.
